title: NA40026: Heat Engines
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Principles of heat transfer; Component efficiency in steam propulsion plants;
Effects of contamination and blowdown; Thermodynamics of steam turbines, diesel
engines and gas turbines; Stoichiometric analysis of fuels; Air requirements.
Analysis of flue gases; Air compressors; Ventilation, air conditioning and
refrigeration in ships.
